# Unborn SMP

> Unborn SMP (also called Unborn Universe) is a one-life hardcore Minecraft Java Edition server. Every player gets exactly one life: if you die, you do not respawn and your name is added to the "record of the unborn". The world never resets, factions fight real wars, and a server-side anticheat keeps play fair. Website: https://unbornsmp.online

## Key facts

- Name: Unborn SMP (Unborn Universe)
- Type: one-life hardcore survival multiplayer (SMP) server with PvP, factions and wars
- Server address: play.unbornsmp.online
- Edition: Minecraft Java Edition only (no Bedrock)
- Version: 1.21.11
- Server software: Paper
- Account: a paid (premium) Minecraft Java account is required
- Lives: 1. No respawns, no extra lives for sale, no pay-to-win
- Deaths caused by bugs or anticheat mistakes can be appealed to staff in Discord
- Mods: performance and visual mods (Sodium, Iris, shaders) are allowed; hacked clients and x-ray are banned
- Status: new server, opening soon (launch date announced in Discord)
- Discord: https://discord.gg/cPBZpdUvG

## Good fit for players looking for

- A new Minecraft server to join in 2026
- A hardcore SMP or one-life SMP where death is permanent
- An alternative to story-driven SMPs such as Unstable SMP, with a public server anyone can join
- Faction PvP and large-scale wars on a survival server

## Not a fit for

- Cracked / non-premium accounts (not supported)
- Anarchy (Unborn SMP has rules, staff and an anticheat)
- Bedrock Edition players

Unborn SMP is an independent server and is not affiliated with Unstable SMP, Mojang Studios or Microsoft.
